title: Bundle signature block (v1)
description: The `_signature/block.json` the signing service inserts into a signed .aceworkflow archive. The root object is the wire form; `payload` is base64 of the exact signed bytes, which decode to a JSON object valid against `#/$defs/payload`. Signatures are Ed25519 over those exact bytes — verifiers verify before parsing and never re-serialize.

chain.description: The intermediate's certificate statement, root-signed. Exactly one link in v1: intermediate -> embedded root.

payload.description: Decoded signed payload. `signedAt` is stamped from the server clock at signing (the signer is the timestamp authority).

extensionId.description: `developer-slug.extension-slug` (exactly two slugs). Reverse-domain ids are rejected: they imply a domain-ownership check nobody performs.

class.description: Provenance mark stamped by the service. A verifier resolves the trust tier from this verified field, never from registry absence; future identity tiers extend the enum without re-signing anything.

files.description: Per-file SHA-256 map over the archive, exact both ways: every archive file except `_signature/block.json` appears here, and every entry exists in the archive. The `_signature/` directory is reserved and never listed.

ed25519Signature.description: base64 of a raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

certificateEnvelope.description: A certificate statement envelope; its payload decodes per certificate-statement.v1.schema.json.

archivePath.description: Forward-slash relative archive path: no leading slash, no backslashes, no empty segments, no `.`/`..` segments, not under the reserved `_signature/` directory.
